description:
In the depths of the Underground Hip Hop scene, a sonic collision of epic proportions has occurred. "Mass Collide" is the latest beat tape to emerge from the shadows, a 9 track instrumental masterpiece that embodies the raw energy and unbridled creativity of the genre.

This explosive collection of beats is the perfect fusion of jazz-infused samples, pulsing electronic elements, and boom bap drums, creating a truly immersive listening experience. From the atmospheric, ambient textures, to the neck-snapping, drum-driven intensity. Each track is a testament to the producer's innovative approach to Hip Hop production.

"Mass Collide" is more than just a beat tape – it's an invitation to join the Underground Hip Hop revolution. With its raw, unapologetic sound and uncompromising energy, this beat tape is sure to resonate with the heads who represent the real Hip Hop -Goomson

Join the collision. Experience the sonic chaos. "Mass Collide" is here. 

All Beats Made By Goomson, Jon Deliz, Mike B, & Ripe143 Appears Courtesy Of The Inner Realmz Featuring Sirrealist & Vel Nine.

Templates By Nikolaj
Composed & Arranged By Goomson
Mixed & Mastered By Dominic Thiroux
Artwork By Fuktory
